newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA ANNUAL CASHMERE OUTPUT HITS 7,000 TONNES.
newsitem.headline: CHINA ANNUAL CASHMERE OUTPUT HITS 7,000 TONNES.

text.p: China's annual cashmere production has hit 7,000 tonnes, accounting for 60 percent of the world's total output, the Business News said on Monday.
China had around 2,000 cashmere producers in 1996, with more than 100 located in Inner Mongolia, including the Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd, the newspaper said.
China's cashmere makers aimed to export more value-added products rather than just raw materials, it said.
The newspaper gave no comparative figures or further details.
